$comment: Figure manifest for the docs screenshots. Consumed by audit.mjs; read by a human (or an agent)
driving capture.ps1 through the app. Every figure is a -light.png / -dark.png pair under
src/assets/<dir>/, captured at the canonical client size below unless it declares a crop.
state    how to reach the figure, from the app's startup state
crop     keep only the top N rows (a strip figure); absent = full window
callout  x,y,w,h of the green #3DC46C highlight box, or absent for no callout
redact   regions pixelated by Save-ClientShot -Redact, for personal data
scrolls  the panel legitimately shows a scrollbar; audit.mjs skips its no-scrollbar rule
skip     why this figure is not re-captured by this pipeline
Callout and redact rects are per-capture pixel coordinates, valid only at the canonical size and
only for the app version they were derived against. Re-derive them -- contentbox.mjs for callouts,
controlbox.mjs for redactions -- rather than nudging them by hand, and record what you used here.
audit.mjs verifies size, edge cleanliness, callout geometry and alignment, redaction containment
and the absence of a scrollbar. It CANNOT verify that a redaction covers the RIGHT thing --
check every redacted figure by eye before committing.
Two rules the frames obey. (1) Left and right clearance are EQUAL -- an earlier version
clamped the right edge to the content-scan limit, so wide groups lost their right pad and the
frame sat on the row's action buttons. (2) Every frame on a tab starts at the same x, which is
what anchorX pins; deriving it per figure put present-on on 475 and its siblings on 474.
The frame MAY cross the scrollbar lane -- it is empty space, and treating it as a boundary is
what caused (1).

redactPolicy: Personal data is pixelated in the capture, not sanitised in the database.
Michal Bartak and Michal Kozusznik: login and full name shown, email domain (everything after
the @) pixelated. Every other person: login, full name and email pixelated in full.
Internal database / schema / object names are NOT redacted (the 1.0.0 assets published them).
Every rect must sit INSIDE the control it covers -- derive it with controlbox.mjs, which returns
the control's inner box; rects sized by eye overhung the input border by 4-8px.

baseline.windowSize: config.yaml window_width 968 / window_height 1144, which restores a 1670x1938 client
baseline.note: Two gotchas: blur an [autofocus] text field (click the dialog heading) or its caret lands in one theme and not the other; and this role's comments DIFFER across clusters, so the inline comment editor only appears after the Comments dialog folds them with 'Use in all clusters' + OK.
